questions.q: Two candidates contested an election. 10% of people on the voting list did not vote and 60 votes recorded were rejected as illegal. The majority of successful candidate was 308 and it was found that he had been supported by 47% of the whole number of the voter's list. What were the total votes.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, winner ko total ka 47% mila hai. Loser ko bache hue valid votes milenge. Ye jo 60 invalid votes hain, ye directly loser ke khate se katenge jisse winner ka margin badh jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total votes ko 100x maan le. Winner le gaya 47x. Toh baaki bacha 43x. Agar sab sahi hota toh margin 4x hota. Par 60 votes invalid the, isiliye margin $308 - 60 = 248$ reh gaya. Seedha $4\% = 248 \implies 1\% = 62$. Toh total $100\% = 6200$. 10 second ka khel hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic se dekhe toh Total = $x$. Valid $= 0.9x - 60$. Winner $= 0.47x$. Loser ko mila $(0.9x - 60) - 0.47x = 0.43x - 60$. Ab equation bana: $0.47x - (0.43x - 60) = 308 \implies 0.04x = 248$.

Exam Takeaway: CGL me jab bhi absolute invalid votes diye hon, unhe margin me se minus karke percentage ke barabar rakh de.

ConceptShortcut
Election MarginWinner % - Loser % = Margin. Always base % on total list.

questions.q: Volume of a cylinder is increased by 43% when its height is reduced by 15 5/13% then find % change in CSA of cylinder?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Fractions pe teri pakad ekdum solid honi chahiye. $15 \frac{5}{13}\%$ dekhte hi dimaag me $\frac{2}{13}$ aana chahiye. Aur 43% (yani 143) chilla ke bata raha hai ki ye 11 aur 13 ka multiple hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Volume $V \propto r^2 h$ hota hai. $V$ ka naya ratio $= \frac{143}{100}$. $h$ ka ratio 13 se 11 ho gaya yani $\frac{11}{13}$.
$$r^2 = \frac{V}{h} = \frac{143/100}{11/13} = \frac{169}{100}$$
Iska matlab $r = \frac{13}{10}$. Ab CSA hota hai $2\pi rh$ jo depend karta hai $r \times h$ par.
CSA Ratio $= \frac{13}{10} \times \frac{11}{13} = \frac{11}{10}$. 10 se 11 ho gaya, seedha $10\%$ increment!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula ratne ki zarurat nahi hai. Volume radius ke square par depend karti hai aur CSA linear hota hai. Bas in multipliers ko dhyan me rakhna hai.

Exam Takeaway: Mensuration ke percentage questions me constants ($2\pi$) ko hamesha ignore maar aur bas proportional ratios use kar.

Math FormulaApplication
Cylinder RatiosVol depends on $r^2 \times h$. CSA depends on $r \times h$.

questions.q: Rohan ordered 5 kg of premium coffee and some additional kilograms of ordinary coffee. The price of the premium coffee per kg was three times that of the ordinary coffee. When the order was delivered. It was found that the quantities of premium and ordinary coffee had been swapped. This change increased his bill by 40%. Find the ratio of the original quantity of premium coffee to the original quantity of ordinary coffee. (CGL TIER I - 14/09/2025-S2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Swapping ka matlab sasti coffee ki jagah mehengi coffee aa gayi, isiliye bill badh gaya. 40% bill badhne ka matlab hai purana bill agar 5 tha toh naya 7 ho gaya.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, options utha aur uda de. Premium:Ordinary ka ratio pucha hai aur Premium 5kg fix hai. Agar hum ratio 1:2 (Option 4) maane, toh ordinary 10kg hogi.
Check kar: Purana Bill $= 5(3) + 10(1) = 25$.
Swapped Bill $= 10(3) + 5(1) = 35$.
Badhotari $= \frac{10}{25} = 40\%$. Ekdum mast match ho gaya!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ordinary quantity ko $x$ maan.
$$3x + 5 = 1.4(15 + x) \implies 3x + 5 = 21 + 1.4x \implies 1.6x = 16 \implies x = 10$$
Toh Original ratio Premium:Ordinary $= 5:10 = 1:2$.

Exam Takeaway: Aise swapping questions me x aur y me ulajhne se zyada fast option se back-calculate karna hota hai.

TrickExplanation
Equation vs OptionsRatio based questions me option put karna fast hota hai.

questions.q: The price of fuel decreases by 55%, 55%, and 55% in three successive months, but increases by 65% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease (rounded off to two decimal places) in the price of fuel in the fourth month, as compared to its original price?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Lagatar 3 baar 55% girne se value zameen par aa jayegi. Uspe chotu sa 65% ka increment ghanta fark nahi daalega. Answer bhayankar decrease (around 85%) hi aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, formula wagaira sab bhool ja, seedha decimals multiplier laga. 55% gira yani $0.45$ bacha.
Net multiplier = $0.45 \times 0.45 \times 0.45 \times 1.65$.
$$0.091125 \times 1.65 \approx 0.1503$$
Yani original value ka lagbhag $15.04\%$ hi bacha hai. Toh decrease kitna hua? $100 - 15.04 = 84.96\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Yahan $X + Y + \frac{XY}{100}$ wala formula lagana apne pairo par kulhadi maarne jaisa hai. Chain reaction decimals me chalana hi padega.

Exam Takeaway: TCS ke successive traps me decimals ko lagbhag 2 places tak approximate karke seedha multiply kar.

TopicShortcut
Successive ChangeUse multiplier $(1 \pm \frac{r}{100})$ instead of formulas.

questions.q: The income of a company increases by x% per year. If its income is 31,25,000 in the year 2019, and the income in 2017 was 20,00,000, then what is the value of x?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: 2 saal ka time gap hai matlab Final/Initial ka ratio ka square root nikalna padega. 3125 aur 2000 me 125 ka common factor saaf dikh raha hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Final aur Initial ka ratio nikal:
$$ \frac{3125000}{2000000} = \frac{3125}{2000} = \frac{25}{16} $$
Do saal ka matter hai toh seedha root le de: $\sqrt{\frac{25}{16}} = \frac{5}{4}$. $\frac{5}{4}$ ka seedha sa matlab hai 1 part ka increment 4 par, jo ki exactly $25\%$ hota hai. Pen free uda diya!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic compound interest wala hisaab hai. $A = P(1 + \frac{R}{100})^T$. Yahan $A=3125$, $P=2000$, $T=2$ rakh ke $R=25$ nikal sakta hai.

Exam Takeaway: Kabhi bhi bade numbers ka root mat le. Hamesha ratio ko lowest form me kaat ke fir root apply kar.

Math ConceptTime Formula
Compound GrowthRate = $(Final/Initial)^{\frac{1}{t}} - 1$.

questions.q: Every day a mango seller sells half his stock, 10% of the stock overnight gets spoiled. If 1983 mangoes rotted over 3 nights then how many did he start with on the first day?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: 1983 ek multiple hai 3 ka (sum of digits 21). Hame ek aisa base chahiye jo baar-baar $\frac{1}{2}$ aur $\frac{1}{10}$ hone par decimals na de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, calculation se bachne ke liye total stock ko 8000 maan le.
Day 1: 4000 beche, 4000 bache, Rot $10\% = 400$.
Day 2: Start 3600 se, 1800 bache, Rot $180$.
Day 3: Start 1620 se, 810 bache, Rot $81$.
Total Rot $= 400 + 180 + 81 = 661$ units.
Question me ye 1983 diya hai, yani $661 \text{ units} = 1983 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 3$.
Total original stock $= 8000 \times 3 = 24,000$. Ekdum makhan calculation!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ye tree method waha zaroori hota hai jahan intermediate additive values (jaise total kharab aam) nikalni hoti hai, sirf final remainder nahi.

Exam Takeaway: Decimals se bachne ke liye fraction denominators ($2$ aur $10$) ko dekh kar apne base ko $10^n$ ya $2^n \times 10^n$ ki terms me set kar liya kar.

Tree Method BaseAssumption Strategy
Zeroes MagicAssume large values like 1000 or 8000 to avoid decimals.

questions.q: The count of bacteria in a sample grows by 24% during the first hour. It decreases by 15% during the next one hour and again decreases by 10% during the third hour. If the present count of bacteria in the sample is 55000, then what will be the net increase/decrease in the count of bacteria after three hours?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Final answer tab nikalega jab numbers jinke end me 1, 7, aur 9 aate hain wo multiply honge. Unit digit method humari mehnat bacha lega bina pura solve kiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, seedha base shift mar.
Final Count $= 55000 \times \frac{124}{100} \times \frac{85}{100} \times \frac{90}{100}$.
$$ = 55000 \times \frac{31}{25} \times \frac{17}{20} \times \frac{9}{10} = 11 \times 31 \times 17 \times 9$$
Ab pura guna mat karna. Last digit check kar: $1 \times 1 \times 7 \times 9 = 3$.
Final count ke aakhiri me 3 aayega. Start 55000 (yani 0) se tha. Decrease $= 10 - 3 = 7$. Jiske aakhiri me 7 hai wahi tera answer hai, yani 2827. Since $11 \times 31 \times 17 \times 9 = 52173$ (chota ho gaya), ye decrease hai.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractions like $\frac{124}{100} = \frac{31}{25}$ use karne se numerator chote rehte hain aur zeroes properly cancel ho jaate hain.

Exam Takeaway: Jab options ke unit digits alag hon, toh puri calculation karne wala gadha hota hai. Unit digit is a god-tier hack.

Calculation TrickImplementation
Unit Digit MethodIgnore full multiplication, just multiply last digits.

questions.q: In class of 100 students, 35 like science and 45 like maths and 10 like both. how many like either of them?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Ye ekdum basic Set Theory ka intersection wala funda hai jisko deviation se bhi treat kiya jaa sakta hai. Bas double counting ko bachana hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Venn Diagram ka direct relation laga:
$$n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$$
$$35 + 45 - 10 = 70$$
Seedha 70 bacche union me aayenge. Ye aise questions hain jo CGL Tier 1 me tere mood ko theek karne ke liye aate hain.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Only Science wale $= 35 - 10 = 25$. Only Maths wale $= 45 - 10 = 35$. Dono wale $= 10$. Total $= 25 + 35 + 10 = 70$.

Exam Takeaway: 'Either' ka matlab hamesha Union ($A \cup B$) hota hai. Isko 'only one of them' se confuse mat karna.

Set Theory RuleLogic
Overlap AvoidanceSubtract common part so it is not counted twice.

questions.q: Abhimanyu's monthly salary in 2014 was Rs. 38000. Due to his good performance, his monthly salary was increased by 10% and 20% in the year 2015 and 2016, respectively with respect to the previous year. Further, there was a provision of deducting 10% of the salary as tax if the salary crosses Rs. 40000 in a month. Find the monthly salary of Abhimanyu in the year 2016 after deducing the tax.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: 38000 par jaise hi pehla 10% lagega wo 41,800 ban jayega yani tax bracket (40,000) cross kar jayega. Iska matlab final salary me se 10% tax pakka katega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, bina ruke successive multipliers laga.
Final Salary $= 38000 \times 1.1 \times 1.2 \times 0.9$
$$= 38000 \times 1.188 = 45144$$
Last digit check karega ya 9 ka multiple dhundhega (digital sum), toh aur fast ud jayega.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Kadam dar kadam badhe toh:
2014 $= 38000$.
2015 me 10% add hua $= 41800$.
2016 me 20% of 41800 add hua $= 50160$.
Ab 40k cross kar gayi toh 10% tax uda de: $50160 - 5016 = 45144$.

Exam Takeaway: Conditions (jaise tax bracket) ko ek baar verify kar le aur fir conditional steps ko seedha successive multiplier chain me daal de.

Salary CalculationMultiplier Method
Net SalaryChain all percentage multipliers back to back.

questions.q: The present population of a village is 15280. If the number of males increases by 25% and the number of females increases by 15%, then the population will become 18428. The difference between present population of males and females in the village is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Total increment $18428 - 15280 = 3148$ ka hua hai. Agar pure gaon ki aabadi sirf 15% se badhti, toh increment kam hota. Ye extra gap sirf un aadmio ke 'extra 10%' ki wajah se hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, seedha JSM chipka. Maan le sab 15% hi badhe.
$$15\% \text{ of } 15280 = 2292$$
Asli me increment $3148$ ka hua. Toh extra kitna aaya? $3148 - 2292 = 856$.
Ye 856 extra aadmio ke 10% ki value hai!
$$10\% \text{ of Males} = 856 \implies \text{Males} = 8560$$
Auraten kitni hui? $15280 - 8560 = 6720$.
Difference $= 8560 - 6720 = 1840$. Seconds me question hawa me!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Normal books tujhe $x$ aur $y$ equations ($x+y=15280$, $1.25x+1.15y=18428$) sikhayengi. Usme mat fasna, 2 minute lag jayenge.

Exam Takeaway: Base ko hamesha chote percentage par shift kar diya kar jisse deviation nikal ke easily values mil jaaye.

Aman Sir TrickConcept Name
JSM (Deviation)Assume the lower percentage for both variables to find excess easily.

questions.q: Two numbers are such that 30% of the first is equal to 45% of the second. What is the ratio of the first to the second? (CHSL TIER I - 22/11/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Jab bhi $aX = bY$ format ho, toh ratio $X:Y$ seedha $b:a$ ban jata hai. Bas coefficients palatne hote hain.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai TestRipper, ye bacchon wala sawal hai: $30\% \times A = 45\% \times B$.
$$ \frac{A}{B} = \frac{45}{30} = \frac{3}{2} $$
Seedha 3:2. Aise sawaalon me pen uthaya toh agle saal phir taiyari karni padegi.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratios hamesha apne percentage weightages ke inverse chalte hain taaki balance maintain rahe.

Exam Takeaway: Linear equations $aX = bY$ dikhte hi coefficient swap karke direct answer mark kar.

Ratio RuleApplication
Inverse RelationIf $xA = yB$, then $A:B = y:x$.

questions.q: P, Q, R and S have different amounts. Q has 2.5 times the amount 'p' has. 's' has 40% less than Q. The amount R has equals the average of all four persons. If the sum of amounts of P and R is 4800, find the amount of R has. (CHSL TIER I - 19/11/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: 40% less ka matlab uske paas 60% hai. Toh $0.6 \times 2.5 = 1.5$. Sabko ek base variable $P$ me convert kar lenge toh equation single variable ki ban jayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, sabko line me laga.
$Q = 2.5P$.
$S = 60\% \text{ of } Q = 0.6 \times 2.5P = 1.5P$.
R sabka average hai: $4R = P + Q + R + S \implies 3R = P + 2.5P + 1.5P = 5P \implies R = \frac{5}{3}P$.
Ab given hai $P + R = 4800 \implies P + \frac{5}{3}P = \frac{8}{3}P = 4800 \implies P = 1800$.
Toh $R = 4800 - 1800 = 3000$. Ekdum badiya set hua!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Isko ratios me tod le: $P:Q:S = 1:2.5:1.5 = 2:5:3$.
Inka sum = 10 units. $R = \frac{10+R}{4} \implies 3R = 10 \implies R = \frac{10}{3}$.
$P+R = 2 + \frac{10}{3} = \frac{16}{3} \equiv 4800$. $1 \text{ unit} = 900$. Toh $R = \frac{10}{3} \times 900 = 3000$.

Exam Takeaway: Decimals se ghabra mat, ek fixed base me equations ko scale kar le, zindagi asaan ho jayegi.

Variable MatchingExecution
Single Variable ReductionConvert all entities to one base variable to simplify.

questions.q: An investor tracks 5 stocks. Four of them have an average return of 8%. If the overall average return is 9%, what was the return on the fifth stock? (CGL TIER I - 25/09/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: 4 stocks apna 9% ka target poora nahi kar pa rahe hain, sab 1% se piche hain. Ye jo gaddha bana hai 4% ka, ye 5th stock ko khud bharna padega apne 9% ke upar se.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, overall target set hai 9% par.
Pehle 4 ne diya 8% yani sabka deficit hua $-1\%$.
Total deficit $= 4 \times (-1\%) = -4\%$.
Ye 4% ki kami kisko poori karni padegi? 5th stock ko!
Return of 5th $= 9\% (uski base value) + 4\% (baki ka compensation) = 13\%$. Bina pen ke 5 second me answer aa gaya!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Bachpan wala tareeka: $Total = 5 \times 9 = 45\%$. $Sum_4 = 4 \times 8 = 32\%$. $5th = 45 - 32 = 13\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Deviation ko dimaag me balance kiya kar, bade numbers me multiplication se bach jayega.

Average HackLogic
Deviation BalancingThe new entry must cover the total deficit of the existing group.

questions.q: Radha has a monthly income of Rs. 80,000. She spends 40% of her income on household expenses, 20% on entertainment and 20% on education. The remaining amount is saved. Due to a 20% salary hike, her income increases. However, her household expenses also rise by 10%, her entertainment costs increase by 12% while her expenses on education remain unchanged. Radha decides to save any leftover income after adjusting these changes. What is the percentage increase in Radha's savings?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Ye 80,000 ek bhayankar trap hai. Jab nikalna hi percentage increase hai, toh absolute numbers ko raste me laane ki zaroorat hi nahi, seedha base 100 se khelna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, absolute value ko side me rakh.
Income ko 100 maan. Expenses hue $= 40 + 20 + 20 = 80$. Save hua $= 20$.
Nayi Income ban gayi $= 120$.
Naye Expenses hue $= 44 (40 \times 1.1) + 22.4 (20 \times 1.12) + 20 = 86.4$.
Nayi Savings $= 120 - 86.4 = 33.6$.
Savings kitni badhi? $33.6 - 20 = 13.6$.
Percentage increment $= \frac{13.6}{20} \times 100 = 68\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar 80,000 ko le kar baithega toh $10880 / 16000$ jaisi bhari terms aayengi, jo answer toh $68\%$ hi dengi par tera poora time khaa jayengi.

Exam Takeaway: Percentage-to-percentage questions me real value ko hamesha ignore maarna hota hai.

Important RuleTrap to Avoid
Ignore Absolute ValuesWhen dealing purely in percentages, never calculate real values.

questions.q: In a Class of MBA Students 16.66% students from Science Background and 12.5% students are from commerce background and 6.66% students from arts background and rest from Engineering Background. The minimum Possible students of Engineering background?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Ye sab standard fractions ki game hai: $\frac{1}{6}$, $\frac{1}{8}$, aur $\frac{1}{15}$. Insaano ko fraction me tod nahi sakte na, isiliye total bache denominators ke LCM ke multiple hone chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, LCM le le denominators (6, 8, 15) ka, jo ki 120 aayega.
Iska matlab minimum class size $= 120$.
Total baaki streams ke bacche $= \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{8} + \frac{1}{15} = \frac{20+15+8}{120} = \frac{43}{120}$.
Toh engineering wale bache honge: $120 - 43 = 77$. Seedha 77 tick kar!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional logic samjh: Ek base minimum ek aisa number hona chahiye jo in sab denominators se puri tarah divide ho jaaye, taki students hamesha integer me hi niklen.

Exam Takeaway: Ulat pulat percentages ko fauran fractions me convert karke denominators ka LCM lekar unhe integer bana diya kar.

Fractions UsedEquivalent Value
16.66%, 12.5%, 6.66%1/6, 1/8, 1/15

questions.q: A student scored 72 marks in a test. If this was 60% of the total, what were the maximum marks? (CHSL TIER I - 21/11/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Agar 60% ki value 72 hai, toh 10% ki value 12 hogi. Pichhe ek zero laga de total aa jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, $60\% = 72 \implies 10\% = 12 \implies 100\% = 120$. Ekdum halwa sawal hai, time bachane ke liye choda hai exam examiner ne.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $0.6X = 72 \implies X = \frac{72}{0.6} = 120$.

Exam Takeaway: Calculations me seedha 1% mat nikal, base 10% tak ghata le, zero lagana bahut smooth rehta hai mental maths me.

Unitary MethodFast Calculation
Scale down to 10%Always find 10% value and append zero for 100%.

questions.q: If the height of a circular cone is increased by 33.33% and its radius is increased by 12.5%, then what will be the change in its volume?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Cone ki volume $\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$ hoti hai. Wo $\frac{1}{3}\pi$ jaise constants ratio nikalte waqt kat jaate hain. Farak sirf $r^2 \times h$ padta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, fraction multipliers bana.
$h$ badha $33.33\%$ yani $+\frac{1}{3} \implies \frac{4}{3}$.
$r$ badha $12.5\%$ yani $+\frac{1}{8} \implies \frac{9}{8}$.
Volume Multiplier $= (\frac{9}{8})^2 \times \frac{4}{3} = \frac{81}{64} \times \frac{4}{3} = \frac{27}{16}$.
Matlab volume 16 se badh kar 27 ho gayi. Increment hua 11 ka.
Percentage chnage $= \frac{11}{16} \times 100 = 11 \times 6.25\% = 68.75\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Isme purana method $a+b+\frac{ab}{100}$ lagana muskil hai kyu ki 3 variables hain (r, r, h). Isiliye fractional chain ratio method sabse best hai.

Exam Takeaway: Standard base fractions ko tips pe rakh, jaise $\frac{1}{16} = 6.25\%$.

Common FractionPercentage
1/166.25%

questions.q: A crate of fruits contains one spoiled fruit for every 25 fruits. 60% of the spoiled fruits were sold. If the seller had sold 48 spoiled fruits, then the number of fruits in the crate were?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Line ko dhyan se padh: "One spoiled fruit for every 25 fruits". Iska matlab hai Spoiled aur Total fruits ka exact ratio 1:25 hai (1:26 mat kar dena).

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Spoiled fruits ka $60\%$ (yani $\frac{3}{5}$) 48 hai.
$$Total Spoiled = 48 \times \frac{5}{3} = 80$$
Ratio humara $1:25$ (Spoiled:Total) chal hi raha hai.
Total Fruits $= 80 \times 25 = 2000$.
Koi dum nahi tha calculation me, bas language ka khel tha.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar usne bola hota "one spoiled fruit for every 25 good fruits", toh ratio 1:26 banta. Bas yahi chhoti reading mistake bachcho ka $-0.5$ karwa deti hai.

Exam Takeaway: "For every X fruits" (matlab base X hai) aur "for every X good fruits" (matlab base X+1 hai) ka trap samajhna seekh le.

Reading TrapLogic
"For every 25 fruits"This means the ratio of Spoiled to Total is 1:25.

questions.q: A solid metallic sphere of radius R is heated so that its radius increases by 10%. Find the approximate percentage increase in its volume. (CHSL TIER I - 25/11/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Sphere ki volume radius ke cube ($r^3$) par depend hoti hai. 10% ka multiplier 1.1 hota hai, toh volume multiplier $1.1^3 = 1.331$ aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai TestRipper, radius 1D hai aur Volume 3D me hai. Increment $10\% = \frac{1}{10}$. Toh multiplier hua $\frac{11}{10}$.
Volume ka ratio nikalo: $(\frac{11}{10})^3 = \frac{1331}{1000}$.
Base 1000 se value 1331 ho gayi. Increment = 331. Base 100 par karega toh $= 33.1\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Bohot log isme bas roughly $3 \times 10 = 30\%$, bol dete hain, par exactly calculate ($1.331$) karna hi thik rehta hai precision options ko clear karne ke liye.

Exam Takeaway: Bhai tu SSC ki tayari kar raha hai, cubes 15 tak tere dimaag me chhape hone chahiye. $11^3 = 1331$ toh sabse common hai.

Cube RulesValue
11 Cube1331

questions.q: A number is decreased by 35%, then increased by 25% and then further increased by 15%. What is the net increase/decrease percentage in the number (correct to the nearest integer)?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Jab itne ajeeb percentages (35%, 25%, 15%) ek saath aa jayein, toh formula lagane se behter direct fraction chain khelna zyada safe hota hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, inko decimals me le.
Multiplier banega $= 0.65 \times 1.25 \times 1.15$.
Ab isko dimaag me tod: $0.65 \times \frac{5}{4} = \frac{3.25}{4} = 0.8125$.
Ab 1.15 se karna hai toh: $0.8125 \times (1 + 0.15) = 0.8125 + 0.121875 = 0.934375$.
Total value base 1 se ghir kar lagbhag 0.934 bachi.
Net chnage $= 1 - 0.934375 = 0.0656$. Yani $6.56\%$ ka decrease hai. Nearest integer 7% decrease hoga.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Varna tu apna formula $X+Y+\frac{XY}{100}$ parts me laga le: $-35 + 25 - 8.75 = -18.75\%$. Phir is result ko 15 ke saath merge kar: $-18.75 + 15 - \frac{18.75 \times 15}{100} = -6.5625\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Multiplication ko split kar ke add karna ($X \times (1 + 0.15)$) traditional lamba guna karne se kahin zyada fast hota hai.

Approximation MethodUsage
Split Multiplication$1.15$ ko $1 + 0.15$ karke add karna fast hota hai.

questions.q: Two saleswomen, Kavitha and Kalyani, are allowed 12% and 15% commission, respectively on the total sales made by them. Kavitha gets 3% and Kalyani gets 5% extra bonus on the sales over Rs. 20,000. If the difference in total earning of both Kavitha and Kalyani is Rs. 7,600, then Kavitha's total earning is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Bonus aur base ko mila ke single equation banane se mamla kaafi sulajh jata hai, bas constant terms ka extra dhyan rakhna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Total Sales ko $S$ maan le.
Kavitha: $12\% S + 3\% (S - 20000) = 15\% S - 600$.
Kalyani: $15\% S + 5\% (S - 20000) = 20\% S - 1000$.
Difference hua $= (20\% S - 1000) - (15\% S - 600) = 5\% S - 400$.
Ye hi humko diya hua hai: $5\% S - 400 = 7600 \implies 5\% S = 8000 \implies S = 1,60,000$
Kavitha Earning nikalni hai: $15\% \text{ of } 160000 - 600 = 24000 - 600 = 23,400$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables ko bracket me theek se open karna zaroori hota hai jab condition $(S - threshold)$ ke bonus par base ho.

Exam Takeaway: Expressions ko hamesha expand kar ke S (variable) ko ek single percentage block me merge kar liya kar.

Algebra ShortcutBenefit
Group PercentagesCombine flat commission and bonus on (S - base) to a single format.

questions.q: Vikas has Rs.x. He gave 44.44% of Rs.x to Anju. Anju bought 33.33% of the money she got from Vikas for a dress and donated 31.25% of the remaining amount. The remaining amount is saved by (y). If the amount donated is 1250, then find the value of (x-y).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Ye pure fraction chain ka chakkar hai. $44.44\% = \frac{4}{9}$, $33.33\% = \frac{1}{3}$, aur $31.25\% = \frac{5}{16}$. Branches ko pakad ke bas link karta ja!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, sequence utha le: Anju ko mila $\frac{4}{9}x$.
Dress pe uda diye $\frac{1}{3}$, bache hue $\frac{2}{3}$.
Toh Remaining amount aaya $= \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{4}{9}x = \frac{8}{27}x$.
Donation hua $31.25\%$ yani remaining ka $\frac{5}{16}$ part.
Donation $= \frac{5}{16} \times \frac{8}{27}x = \frac{5}{54}x$. Aur yehi 1250 hai.
$\frac{5}{54}x = 1250 \implies x = 13500$.
Ab Save $(y)$ hua bacha hua $\frac{11}{16}$ hissa.
$y = \frac{11}{16} \times \frac{8}{27}x = \frac{11}{54}x$.
Value rakh $y = \frac{11}{54} \times 13500 = 2750$.
Pucha kya hai? $x - y = 13500 - 2750 = 10750$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek bade percentage wale lambaue sawal ko tu single equation ratios me baant sakta hai jo tezi se cancel ho jaati hai.

Exam Takeaway: Ajeeb fractions jaise $31.25\% = 5 \times 6.25\% = \frac{5}{16}$ rate hue hone chahiye warna waqt bekar kharab hoga.

Percentage TableFraction Form
44.44%, 31.25%4/9, 5/16

questions.q: Two numbers are less than a third number by 30% and 37% respectively. The percent by which the second number is less than the first is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: CGL me hamesha is word "than the first" pe focus kar, kyuki wahi tera denominator base set karta hai. Seedhi percentages minus karne ka game nahi hai ye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, seedha Third number ko 100 maan.
Toh First hua $= 70$. Second hua $= 63$.
Pucha kya hai? Second first se kitna chota hai?
Difference $= 70 - 63 = 7$.
Percentage on First $= \frac{7}{70} \times 100 = 10\%$.
Options me 7% janbujh kar rakha gaya hai taki bache fatafat $37-30=7$ mark karein aur gadhe kehlayein.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Step by step: Identify Base $\rightarrow$ Shift Base $\rightarrow$ Compare. Wahi base rule.

Exam Takeaway: English ke "than" aur "of" shabd ke theek baad aane wala word humesha denominator banta hai, yaad rakhio.

Base RuleWarning
Relative ComparisonAlways check the 'than' keyword to identify the denominator base.

questions.q: A and B contested in an election in a village. A got y% of the total number of votes and B got (y - 48)% of the total number of votes and the ratio of the total number of votes obtained by A to B is 15:11. Find the total number of voters in the village, if (4y/9)% of the total number of votes is 6000.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dono percentages ka base ek hi hai (Total number of votes), toh hum unke ratios ko directly equate kar sakte hain, koi alag assumption ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai TestRipper, isko fauran cross-multiply kar:
$$ \frac{A}{B} = \frac{y}{y - 48} = \frac{15}{11} $$
$$11y = 15y - 720 \implies 4y = 720 \implies y = 180$$
Ab aakhiri line pakad: $(\frac{4y}{9})\% = \frac{4 \times 180}{9}\% = 80\%$.
Total ka $80\% = 6000$ hai, toh $100\% = \frac{6000}{80} \times 100 = 7500$.
Wait kar, options me toh 7500 hai hi nahi! Ye hote hain SSC ke faulty questions. Aise me options me sabse closest value test kar. Jaise 6750 ka 80% nikalega toh 5400 aayega (closest logical fit to language anomaly). Option 6750 yahan real exam me sabse apt trick guess mana jayega.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Faulty questions har saal nikalte hain TCS me. Apna math pakka rakh aur closest option ya error approach par strike kar.

Exam Takeaway: Ratio matching ka use kar aur contradictory options aane par apna balance lose mat karna; TCS galti karta hai, tu mat karna.

Option EliminationExam Strategy
Faulty QuestionsUse ratio matching to find the closest logical option when language contradicts.

questions.q: For the Couse of corona various govt told that some employee stays at home so in an organization yesterday 13% male and 20% female employee were absent but today 8% female and 31% male employee are absent but number of male and female are equal present today. If Total number of employees present were 3528 in the organisation yesterday then find total number of employees in the organisation?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Aaj (today) ke data se 'present equal' wali line humko direct ratio nikal ke degi male-to-female ka. Ek baar ratio nikal gaya toh '100x' variable use kar ke calculations me point laane se bach jayenge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, aaj ki present halat par gaur kar.
Today Present Male $= (100 - 31)\% = 69\% M$.
Today Present Female $= (100 - 8)\% = 92\% F$.
Dono ko barabar rakh: $0.69 M = 0.92 F \implies \frac{M}{F} = \frac{92}{69} = \frac{4}{3}$
Ab assume kar le $M = 400x$ aur $F = 300x$. Toh Total hua $= 700x$.
Kal (Yesterday) kya scene tha: Present $M = 87\% \text{ of } 400x = 348x$.
Present $F = 80\% \text{ of } 300x = 240x$.
Total Yesterday Present $= 348x + 240x = 588x$.
Ye 588x diya hai 3528 ke barabar.
$$588x = 3528 \implies x = \frac{3528}{588} = 6$$
Total employees huye $700 \times 6 = 4200$. Ekdum pro wala attack hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute terms nikalne se pehle humesha conditions ka istemal kar ke seedha ratios set kar liya kar, time zero barbaad hoga.

Exam Takeaway: Ratio lock hote hi '00x' (hundred-x) approach lagana percentage extracting ko hamesha integers me badal deta hai.

Equating MethodZeroes Trick
Ratio GenerationFind ratio first, then append '00x' to make percentage calculation integer-based.
